scope: Scientific and editorial recheck of authored documentation and its substantive sources. Verification performed 2026-10-21 UTC during the review dated 2026-10-20 in the user’s local date.
limits: Targeted source verification, not a new comprehensive systematic literature review. Historical searches and results are preserved.
full_text means the relevant accessible body was inspected; limitations state partial extraction coverage where applicable.
Metadata-only entries support provenance or attribution only. Published findings do not validate this project’s own results.

references.title: Puromycin literal dataset
supported_claims: 23 values, factor labels and source ordering; deterministic conversion into the project CSV.
limitations: A mirror of R source, not the original experimental records. Repeated rows are not documented independent biological replicates.

references.title: Puromycin: Reaction Velocity of an Enzymatic Reaction
references.version: same pinned commit; current R-devel manual also inspected
supported_claims: Archived units, initial-rate description, one experiment per label, historical attribution and the separate-fit/partial-linearity examples.
limitations: Description refers to cells while details refer to treated enzyme. The reduced archive cannot resolve species, substrate identity, full protocol, calibration or causal design.

rechecks.finding: The current official manual still gives 23 observations, recorded units, one experiment per label, and separate nonlinear fits. It does not resolve the cells/enzyme wording or missing assay metadata.
rechecks.limits: Targeted source/version check, not independent validation of the project's scientific result.

references.title: A Note on the Kinetics of Enzyme Action
supported_claims: Bibliographic attribution of the historical theoretical treatment.
limitations: PubMed record has no abstract. The current full-text request returned an internal error; original derivation was not inspected in this pass. The detailed Km explanation is independently supported by Johnson and Goody (2011).
references.citation: Briggs GE, Haldane JBS. (1925). A Note on the Kinetics of Enzyme Action. Biochemical Journal, 19(2), 338–339.

rechecks.finding: Title, issue year and DOI agree with the cited item. This pass did not appraise the article body.
rechecks.limits: No full-text reappraisal or new systematic search is claimed; earlier access records are preserved.

references.title: The Original Michaelis Constant: Translation of the 1913 Michaelis–Menten Paper
supported_claims: Historical assumptions and distinction between a kinetic Michaelis constant and binding affinity.
limitations: The translated 1913 experiment is not the Puromycin archive. Full text read in two chunks; redistribution rights are not inferred from access. PubMed includes Michaelis and Menten in its author list, whereas the primary publisher and PMC article header identify Johnson and Goody as article authors.
corrections: Preserved the two article authors verified against primary publisher and PMC headers; documented the PubMed author-list discrepancy.
references.citation: Johnson KA, Goody RS. (2011). The Original Michaelis Constant: Translation of the 1913 Michaelis–Menten Paper. Biochemistry, 50(39), 8264–8269.

rechecks.finding: Title, issue year and DOI agree with the cited item. The abstract was re-read for the limited claim used in this project.
rechecks.limits: No full-text reappraisal or new systematic search is claimed; earlier access records are preserved.

limitations: 2024 is the issue year; the article appeared online in 2023. Abstract-level appraisal only. Its substrate-competition mechanism is not the two-parameter Puromycin curve.
